blocks.caption: The anvil of the Wing Forge

blocks.text: If the table is where wings are born, the bench is where they are bred. Every harness, every core, every feather of every wing is hammered out here.

It stands in the Wing Forge, an island that appears in the End when the dragon dies for the third time. Follow the Forge Compass. It can be mined with a pickaxe and placed anywhere; the next dragon death grows a new one in the forge.

A 5 by 5 grid without its four corners: 21 cells, three on the top and bottom rows, five on the three middle rows. Recipes are shaped. When the ingredients match and the gauges hold enough essence, the result appears; take it and the essence is paid.

blocks.caption: Flasks, absorbers, tanks, intermediates and wing parts

blocks.text: It makes the wing pieces and their intermediates, the Essence Flask, the Cloud Absorbers and the Essence Tanks. A rare piece costs 10 to 30 Cloud Essence; the higher the rarity, the more essences a piece asks for.
Place any item in its slot and click Imbue to give it winged energy, or Cleanse to take it back. Imbued tools, weapons and rods collect the mod's drops.
Like the Assembly Table, the bench keeps four gauges of 1,000 units, filled by dropping a flask or tank in its essence slot.
